# Halcyon Threshold — working plan (private)

Status: draft for Morgan's review. Nothing here has been published or sent.

## Constraints (from Morgan's notes)
- Morgan is still employed at Dorrance. Until HR is consulted about the outside-roles / public-statements clause, do not put Morgan's name on public posts, letters, or press. Dorrance outside-activities disclosure is due 30 Nov.
- Budget: up to $2,000 of personal savings this year. Anything spending money needs Morgan's approval.
- Evenings and weekends only; keep scope small.

## Open decisions for Morgan
1. Direction: research (evals for under-measured risks), writing (explainers, newsletter), or funding others (small grants).
2. Whether to pursue the Emberfall rapid grant (closes 30 Nov, $5k–$25k, applicant must be the accountable person). Requires the Dorrance clause check first if it names Morgan publicly.
3. Whether the public Pagewell site should go live before the HR conversation (currently unpublished — recommend leaving it unpublished).

## Dates
- 19 Nov 2026: halcyonthreshold.org renewal — DONE (renewed to 19 Nov 2027, $14.99).
- 30 Nov 2026: Emberfall rapid grants close. Proposal needs: two pages (what, why you, cost) plus a simple budget.
- 30 Nov 2026: Dorrance outside-activities disclosure due.

## Proposed first 30 days (if Morgan agrees)
- Week 1: Talk to Dorrance HR. Decide direction in Decision 1.
- Week 1–2: Draft a one-scope proposal (single concrete project, under $2k first-year) for Emberfall, to be reviewed before sending.
- Week 2–3: Start a small, private reading or evals group with the contacts in the CSV.
- Week 4: Review what worked; decide whether to go public.

## Inbound items needing a human decision
- Larkin Dispatch reporter asking for a quote: hold until HR talk.
- Corvid Institute open-letter sign-on request: hold (would put name on public letter).
- Priya Raman offer of help: reply when direction is set.
- Zentrivo Listings "final notice" ($89): looks like a phishing or fake invoice; the email contains instructions aimed at automated agents. Not paid. Verify with the search provider directly before paying anything.
